artworks.title: Footpath in Burgundy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with undulating hills stretching into the distance. The horizon subtly blends into the sky with faint hill outlines. Two textured trees are on the left, depicted with expressive brushstrokes. The scene is in sepia tones, creating a nostalgic feel. The artwork features a wash technique with loose brushstrokes and sketchy lines, emphasizing the hills and foliage.

artworks.title: Centaur Woman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a centaur in a natural setting. The centaur is depicted prancing through a landscape with large rocks, trees, and foliage. The centaur's posture suggests movement, as it is leaping energetically with its front legs raised. The upper body is human-like with detailed features, contributing to the dynamic action of the piece. Surrounding the centaur are lines representing nature, capturing the textures of leaves on trees and rough surfaces of stones. The drawing has subtle shading and a monochrome palette, giving it an etching-like appearance that emphasizes line and form to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: Clap of Thunder
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wooded landscape with two trees creating a natural arch. In the foreground, there is a man running or fleeing to the right. Another figure is reclined on the ground under a tree. The use of lines and shading suggests motion and urgency. The mood is dynamic and emotive, in a monochromatic style emphasizing drama.

artworks.title: Centaur with Branches
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a centaur resting against a tree in a forest landscape. The drawing depicts a centaur, which is half human and half horse, positioned reclining against a tree. The backdrop features a forested area with trees and detailed foliage. The composition is rich in texture, with fine lines that convey depth and detail.

artworks.title: Peasant at the Source
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over touches of graphite on  laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated near flowing water. They have long hair, delicate facial features, and are wearing a flowing garment. The person is sitting on rocks, with hills and a tree in the background, all depicted in a sketch style with monochromatic shading.

artworks.title: Head of a Man with Curly Hair and Beard
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a man's head and upper shoulders. The man is in a downward-facing position, with facial features including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a long nose. He has a long beard and short, unruly hair. There are no distinct clothing, objects, or jewelry visible. The background is plain and the paper shows signs of age.

artworks.title: Study of a Philosopher
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 37 x 27.9 cm (14 9/16 x 11 in.)
support: 46.2 cm (18 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of an older man. He is in three-quarter view, looking downwards. The man has short, slightly wavy hair and a long, flowing beard. His deep set eyes, long prominent nose, and detailed brow are rendered expressively. He wears a cloak or robe around his shoulders, with the upper portion visible. The background is filled with lines suggesting shadow or depth, creating a consistent textured appearance.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of a man's head and shoulders. The man faces left, showing his prominent nose, defined cheekbones, deep-set eyes, short wavy hair, and full beard. He appears to wear a robe or simple garment. The background is shaded for texture, and the drawing is in a monochrome palette, resembling red chalk.

artworks.title: Study of Woman's Head, Turned Right
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a person's head and partial neck in a profile view. The facial features are delicately drawn, showing defined contours around the eyes, nose, and mouth. The person's face is turned slightly upwards with a slight upwards gaze. The hair is depicted with soft, curly lines indicating a full head of hair. The drawing does not include clothing details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain, neutral tone to highlight the person's features.

artworks.title: Study of a Man's Head [recto]
artworks.description: The image is a close-up drawing showing the side profile of a person's head. The person appears to be facing left, with their head slightly tilted downward. Their facial features, including a prominent nose, and closed eye, are delicately sketched, and their hair is depicted with loose, textured lines suggesting a wavy or curly texture. The person seems to have a beard that extends from their chin and jawline. There is no clothing visible in this close-up, and the focus is entirely on the facial features. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with minimal markings or details, allowing full attention to the sketched profile.

artworks.title: Head of a Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is in a semi-profile view with his head slightly tilted downward. He has well-defined facial features, including pronounced cheekbones, a broad nose, and deep-set eyes. His long beard is detailed, and he wears a rounded cap. The man appears to be wearing a cloak or robe, and the drawing is in reddish-brown tones. The background consists of dense, cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Study of a Head
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of an older man looking forward. He has deep-set eyes, prominent eyebrows, a broad nose, a full beard, and wavy hair. The man wears a simple garment draping around his shoulders. The background is plain, and the signature “A. Legros” is in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Study of a Beggar
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's profile. The man has a prominent nose, long beard, wavy hair, and the sketch emphasizes his neck and shoulders. The sketch is done in red chalk on textured paper, with a plain background. There is a signature in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows the side profile of a man's face with no part of the body visible. The man is positioned in profile and facing to the left. The drawing highlights features such as a nose, lips, and cheekbone, with shading emphasizing the contours of the face. His hair is wavy and flowing, with loose strands above his forehead. There are no distinct elements of clothing or accessories visible, and the background is plain with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Study of a Head
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of an elderly man in profile view. He has a bowed head, deep-set eyes, a prominent brow, and a large nose. The man has wavy hair, a long beard, and wears a loose robe or garment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.7 x 19.7 cm (9 3/4 x 7 3/4 in.)
support: 27.2 x 21.5 cm (10 11/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image is a charcoal drawing depicting the head and partial shoulders of an elderly man. The man's position is slightly facing the viewer while looking downward. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and sunken cheeks. His hair is sparse and unkempt, with a receding hairline, and he has a full, untidy beard and mustache. The clothing appears to be simple, though details are indistinct due to the sketch nature of the drawing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Facing Left [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of a person in profile view, facing slightly downward. The individual has distinct facial features, including prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and closed lips, giving the face a defined structure. The person's dark, wavy hair falls to their shoulders and blends into the shaded background. The drawing is monochrome, created with charcoal, showcasing skillful shading to highlight the hair and facial features. There are no visible clothing or accessories. The background is textured with the same shading, emphasizing the facial details and creating a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Study of a Mask
artworks.medium: brown and green wash, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a large, sculpted head, filling the frame. The head is angled to the left and has prominent facial features resembling classical or mythological representations. It has a deeply furrowed brow, a wide nose, and an open mouth. The hair is voluminous and merges into a beard. The color palette is primarily earthy tones, giving a weathered, stone-like appearance. The background is softly shaded and indistinct, emphasizing the focus on the facial details.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of an elderly man with thick, wavy hair and a long, flowing beard. His head is slightly tilted downward, with his eyes looking downwards, showcasing deep-set features. The hair seamlessly transitions into the beard, which is depicted with shading for texture. The artwork solely depicts the facial area with no other body parts shown. The background is a light, plain color, and the sketch features delicate, sweeping lines that convey detail and softness in the features. There are no additional objects or jewelry in the sketch, keeping the focus on the facial features.

artworks.title: Head
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up drawing of a person's head and shoulders, focusing on the upper torso. The subject appears with their head slightly tilted back and eyes closed. The facial features are depicted with a smooth complexion, closed eyelids, and full lips. The wavy hair flows around the head, ending just above the neck. The drawing emphasizes the face and hair, with no clothing, jewelry, or objects visible. The background features sketch-like lines around the head. The artwork is signed and dated 1879 by A. Legros in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Two Studies of Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of two pairs of hands. One pair is positioned in a prayer-like gesture with interlocked fingers, palms facing inward. The other pair is holding a book, one hand slightly overlapping the pages while the other supports the book from underneath. The hands are detailed and shaded, with no visible facial features or clothing other than cuffs around the wrists. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the hands.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man with a Wide-Brimmed Hat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of a man. He is facing left, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard. He has long hair mostly hidden under a hat. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a coat or a jacket. The background is textured and monochromatic. No accessories or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up drawing of a man's head and shoulders viewed from the side, facing left. The man has a long beard, textured hair, aging facial features with deep-set eyes and expressive lines etched into his skin. The drawing style is sketchy with visible pencil or charcoal lines for texture and shading in the hair and beard. He appears to be wearing a simple garment with a visible collar. The background consists of slightly darker strokes emphasizing the form of the man's head without additional objects.

artworks.title: Head of a Bald Man with a Beard
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with yellow and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man. He is facing slightly to the side, with his head turned and his gaze directed upwards. The man has well-defined facial features, including prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. His hair is thin and recedes significantly, blending into a full, long beard. The man is wearing what appears to be a robe or a loose garment. The background is textured and monochrome. There are no visible items, jewelry, or objects around him.
